criteria.requirement: Ordinary date parsing yields a midnight UTC DateTime;exact=True preserves Date,and the exact time string yields Time. Define expected field types before parsing,require explicit timezone/offset where an instant is needed,and reject or explicitly resolve missing components instead of inventing midnight/UTC semantics. Preserve raw text and normalized typed values and test invalid/ambiguous input. Successful parsing alone does not establish a complete event instant.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
